item.title: Zepto IPO: Fast growth, high losses, and valuation uncertainty
item.description:
Zepto's IPO filing reveals rapid expansion, with advertising revenue jumping 151%. This growth outpaced the company's 104% increase in operating revenue, leading to questions about its valuation.
